input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: First quick run stalled ~13 min: HistGradientBoosting OpenMP threads x ProcessPool workers oversubscribed 4 cores; fixed with OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 (fits 0.4 s each after).
First full run crashed: a feature observed in the source group but all-NaN on the rows carrying the item (another ballot) broke HGB binning; features now filtered on the item rows.

doc_friction.issue: The OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 note is framed for GP/BLAS; sklearn HistGradientBoosting inside ProcessPoolExecutor hits the same oversubscription (cost ~13 min here). Worth generalising to any OpenMP model in a process pool.
pkill hook rejects a bracketed pattern if the same text appears elsewhere in the command line; the CLAUDE.md hint ("first letter bracketed") does not mention this, cost one retry.

notes: Routed research/0, drew programme christian-belief-models (claim check clear). Milestone 6 step: exact decomposition of transferred-imputation level error into label-free covariate shift (importance-weighted source residual) and concept shift, over 241 cells / 20 source->target pairs on GSS 1972-2024. Predictions pre-registered in LOG.md before the full run. Refutation rule met: proxy shift from co-asked items does not correct the unasked item (E3 -0.35 points, pair-cluster 95% -0.74 to +0.01). Checks run locally: 30 tests pass, research/_homepage/build.py ok, research_live_links ok, check_md_links ok, cite_check ok (4 DOIs + PPI DOI), programme_check ok, post frontmatter ok, post similarity 0 pairs.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: design of the decomposition and estimators, code, tests, 20-pair run, write-up: about 1.5 days for a quantitative sociologist

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
